title: Unify three blob-download implementations on lib/download
body:
## Summary
QuestGeneratorPanel and CodeViewer hand-roll the anchor download and revoke the blob URL synchronously; lib/download.ts defers the revoke because a synchronous one can yield 0-byte files.

## Description
src/components/modules/game-systems/DialogueView/QuestGeneratorPanel.tsx:93-106 and src/components/ui/CodeViewer.tsx:32-42 call URL.revokeObjectURL(url) right after a.click(); src/lib/download.ts:12-19 documents that this races the download and defers it 150 ms, but does not append the anchor to the body (the reason the other two hand-roll). Fixed = downloadBlob appends/removes the anchor and both call sites use it.

## Flow
- add body append/remove to downloadBlob
- replace QuestGeneratorPanel.downloadJson and CodeViewer.triggerDownload with downloadBlob
- jsdom test: revoke is not called synchronously after click

## Expected impact
Users exporting quests or code stop risking empty files on browsers that race the revoke. Could break: Firefox download if the append is dropped.

## Evaluation
Claim: resilience - one download path with deferred revoke
Before: 3 implementations, 2 with synchronous revoke
After: predicted 1 implementation, 0 synchronous revokes at these 2 sites
Method: simulation - lib/download.ts and ui/CodeViewer.tsx are outside this context
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: vitest spy on URL.revokeObjectURL asserting 0 synchronous calls after click, at both call sites

title: Extract the four copy-pasted status banners in WriteToProjectButton
body:
## Summary
The dry-run modal repeats one banner style block (OPACITY_10 bg, OPACITY_30 border, icon, text) four times.

## Description
src/components/modules/game-systems/blueprint-transpiler/BlueprintTranspilerView/WriteToProjectButton.tsx:283-359 renders not-a-ue-project, module-not-in-build, api-macro-mismatch and code-stale banners with identical inline style objects differing only in STATUS_ERROR/STATUS_WARNING; the Confirm/Re-run buttons at :403-438 repeat one style three times. The file is 446 LOC. A local StatusBanner(tone) collapses them.

## Flow
- add StatusBanner(tone, icon, children, action?)
- replace the 4 blocks
- blueprint-write-verify + overwrite-review tests stay green (they key on data-testid)

## Expected impact
Banner styling changes once; file shrinks ~60 LOC. Could break: a data-testid dropped in the move.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - duplicated banner blocks 4 -> 1
Before: 4 banner blocks (grep "OPACITY_10}`" -> 4), 446 LOC
After: predicted 1 block, ~385 LOC
Method: simulation - counted; refactor not built this round
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: blueprint-write-verify.test.tsx + blueprint-overwrite-review.test.tsx as regression gate; LOC and grep count before/after

title: Transpiler tab bar and .h/.cpp toggle expose no selected state
body:
## Summary
The Transpile/Semantic Diff tab bar and the header/source toggle are plain buttons with no role=tab/aria-selected or aria-pressed, while ui/TabBar exists.

## Description
src/components/modules/game-systems/blueprint-transpiler/BlueprintTranspilerView/index.tsx:60-77 hand-rolls tabs; TranspilePane.tsx:178-195 hand-rolls the .h/.cpp toggle. The active state is conveyed by background colour only. src/components/ui/TabBar.tsx already implements the tab contract.

## Flow
- adopt ui/TabBar in index.tsx (or role=tablist/tab + aria-selected)
- add aria-pressed to the two code-file toggles
- test: [aria-selected=true] = 1 and [aria-pressed=true] = 1

## Expected impact
Screen-reader users hear which tab and which file is shown. Could break: e2e selectors keyed on button text.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - selected state announced
Before: 0 aria-selected / aria-pressed in BlueprintTranspilerView/*.tsx
After: predicted 4 (2 tabs, 2 toggles)
Method: probe - grep count; not built (TabBar adoption is a visual choice)
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: RTL test counting aria-selected/aria-pressed true = 1 each

title: Status hues in this context bypass the STATUS_* tokens (17 sites)
body:
## Summary
Errors, warnings and successes are coloured with raw Tailwind palette classes in the same files that use STATUS_* tokens for the same meanings.

## Description
text-red-400 / text-amber-400 / text-green-400 / text-yellow-400 etc. appear 17 times across BlueprintTranspilerView, DialogueView and multiplayer (e.g. TranspilePane.tsx:107,149,164,241; WriteToProjectButton.tsx:254; ReplicationScaffoldPanel.tsx error banner; QuestGeneratorPanel.tsx:145,233; WorldScanSummary.tsx:89-105), while WriteToProjectButton/DiffPane use STATUS_ERROR/STATUS_WARNING. Two vocabularies for one status set drift under theming.

## Flow
- map each class to STATUS_* (style) or a token utility class
- source-scan test: 0 text-(red|amber|green|yellow)-400 in context files

## Expected impact
Status colours follow the theme consistently. Could break: visual shade shifts only.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one status vocabulary
Before: 17 raw palette status classes
After: 0
Method: probe - grep count; fix-as-you-touch migration, not bulk this round
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: comment-stripped source-scan test counting raw palette classes

title: Semantic-diff conflict level is shown by dot colour only
body:
## Summary
ChangeCard signals none/compatible/conflict with a coloured dot and nothing else (WCAG 1.4.1).

## Description
src/components/modules/game-systems/blueprint-transpiler/BlueprintTranspilerView/ChangeCard.tsx: the conflict dot is aria-hidden with only a title; ui/StatusToken (colour+glyph+pattern) exists for this. Colour-blind and SR users cannot tell a conflict row from a compatible one without expanding it.

## Flow
- replace the dot with StatusToken or CONFLICT_STYLES.icon + label
- test: each card exposes its conflict label

## Expected impact
Conflict rows distinguishable without colour. Could break: row width.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - status not hue-only
Before: 1 hue-only indicator per card
After: glyph + accessible label
Method: simulation - read the render
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: ChangeCard.tsx conflict dot: <span className="w-2 h-2 rounded-full ..." style={{ backgroundColor: conflictStyle.color }} aria-hidden />
instrument: RTL test asserting conflictStyle.label reachable per card

title: Write receipt from a previous class survives a re-transpile
body:
## Summary
WriteToProjectButton keeps its receipt/compile verdict in local state, so after transpiling a different Blueprint the old "Wrote N files" line sits next to the new code.

## Description
WriteToProjectButton.tsx:131-132 receipt/compile are reset only in dryRun (:172). TranspilePane renders the button with a stable identity across results, so a new non-stale result for another class leaves the old receipt visible until the next dry-run.

## Flow
- transpile A, write, transpile B
- observe the receipt still shown
- fix: reset receipt when className/header changes, or key the button by result

## Expected impact
The receipt cannot be mistaken for B. Could break: receipt cleared after re-transpiling the same class.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - receipt bound to the code it describes
Before: receipt persists across result change (walked)
After: cleared on result change
Method: simulation - walked props/state; no RTL harness built
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: RTL rerender with new header/className asserting write-receipt absent

title: Shared CopyButton swallows a denied clipboard write silently
body:
## Summary
ui/CopyButton catches the clipboard rejection and shows nothing, so a failed copy looks like a no-op.

## Description
src/components/ui/CopyButton.tsx:58-66 catch { leave state false }. Registry ui-controls/micro-interaction-contracts, copy affordance rule 3: failure is not silence. Replication, QuestCard and QuestGeneratorPanel now all route through it, so the gap lives in one place.

## Flow
- add a failed state (icon + aria-label "Copy failed") for the feedback window
- test: rejected writeText -> aria-label contains failed

## Expected impact
Users learn the copy did not happen. Could break: callers asserting label text.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - failed copy is visible
Before: denied write -> 0 visible signals
After: 1 failure state
Method: simulation - read the catch; component outside this context
Result: better
Gate: none
evidence: src/components/ui/CopyButton.tsx:64-65 } catch { // clipboard write blocked - leave state false

title: Quest metric tiles enumerate categories by hand beside CATEGORY_LABELS
body:
## Summary
QuestGeneratorPanel lists the five categories as a literal array next to the CATEGORY_LABELS record that already enumerates them.

## Description
src/components/modules/game-systems/DialogueView/QuestGeneratorPanel.tsx:207 literal (['main','side','bounty','exploration','fetch'] as QuestCategory[]); DialogueView/constants.ts CATEGORY_LABELS is Record<QuestCategory,...> so TS forces it complete, the array is not. A new category gets a label but no tile and its quests drop out of the counts.

## Flow
- derive tiles from Object.keys(CATEGORY_LABELS)
- test: tile count equals Object.keys(CATEGORY_LABELS).length

## Expected impact
Counts stay complete when categories change. Could break: tile order.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - one enumeration
Before: 2 enumerations, 1 unchecked
After: 1
Method: simulation - no category exists yet that would expose it
Result: better
Gate: none
instrument: RTL test comparing rendered tile count to CATEGORY_LABELS keys

title: World Scan summary is a fixed 4-column grid
body:
## Summary
WorldScanSummary uses grid-cols-4 with no breakpoint, cramping counts and labels on narrow panes; category is carried by icon hue.

## Description
src/components/modules/game-systems/DialogueView/WorldScanSummary.tsx:20 grid grid-cols-4; other panes in this context stack at md (TranspilePane md:flex-row).

## Flow
- grid-cols-2 sm:grid-cols-4
- screenshot at 360px

## Expected impact
Readable at phone/split widths. Could break: nothing functional.

## Evaluation
Claim: user - no overflow at narrow width
Before: 4 columns at every width
After: 2 below sm
Method: simulation - jsdom cannot lay out
Result: better
Gate: none

title: Unknown project parent class could auto-include its own header
body:
## Summary
After the carry fix a Blueprint whose parent is a project C++ class (AMyBase) gets a warning but no include; UE naming would be "MyBase.h".

## Description
src/lib/blueprint-cpp-codegen.ts parentIncludeFor returns null for non-engine parents and codegen warns. Guessing <Name sans prefix>.h matches UE file naming for game-module classes and would compile in the common case, keeping the warning as a hint.

## Flow
- for unknown A/U-prefixed parents emit #include "<Stripped>.h" plus an info warning
- test over AMyBase
- prove with a UE compile

## Expected impact
Fewer hand edits when subclassing project bases. Could break: a wrong guess is a missing-file error instead of a missing-type error.

## Evaluation
Claim: quality - generated header compiles for project bases
Before: 0 includes + warning for AMyCustomBase
After: 1 guessed include + info
Method: simulation - needs a UE compile to prove
Result: unmeasurable
Gate: none
evidence: src/__tests__/lib/blueprint-cpp-codegen.test.ts "warns when the parent header is unknown" (AMyCustomBase -> no include)
instrument: pof_ue_compile of a generated subclass of a project base class (blueprint-tools owner)
